operations.content: Hermes mcp login (browser OAuth) fails for custom servers even with client_id set; work instead by manual PKCE: register via server register endpoint, build authorize URL, catch code on localhost listener, exchange at token endpoint, store as mcp-tokens/<name>.json + .meta.json + .client.json (verified with n8n).
n8n SplitInBatches v3 outputs are [done, loop]: output 0 emits processedItems when finished, output 1 emits the next batch. Wire done->downstream and loop->back-edge accordingly.
n8n Code node default mode is runOnceForAllItems ($json = first item only); set mode runOnceForEachItem explicitly for per-item JS, or iterate $input.all() in once mode.

TrailCode/Graft: pin @nanonets/graft@0.15.0 because 0.25.x serves deferred tools this client reads as empty; the MCP server resolves its repo from cwd, so run it via wrapper scripts that cd into the indexed repo first.
Windows git defaults to helper-selector popup on auth; set repo-local credential.helper to manager and use GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 for silent background pushes.
Hermes secrets go to .env via `hermes config set NAME value`; config.yaml must carry ${VAR} references only, never plaintext keys — verify with a scan before any git commit.
